name: Sanctus
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking down a long gothic nave of pointed arcades, triforium and clerestory toward a glowing triple lancet at the east end: a broad stained-glass sunbeam in rose and wine cuts diagonally across the blue-black stone, laying soft coloured window patches on the far piers. Dust wisps drift through the beam and the sun swings slowly, sliding the patches along the arcade.

params.label: Shafts
params.effect: Brightness of the sunbeams hanging in the air of the nave.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: How much dust swirls in the beams and how many motes catch the light.

params.label: Sun height
params.effect: How steeply the sun falls through the windows, moving the patches across piers and floor.
